title: The Rocky Four
objective: After this level you can name the rocky planets and explain why Venus, not Mercury, is the hottest.
summary: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are rocky. Venus is the hottest planet thanks to its heat-trapping atmosphere, and Mars is red because of rust.

cards.headline: Mercury is closest to the Sun. So why is Venus hotter?
The inner planets are rocky
cards.body: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are small worlds of rock and metal. You could, in principle, stand on any of them. You wouldn't enjoy most of them.

cards.headline: Venus: a runaway greenhouse
cards.body: Venus is wrapped in a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere that traps heat. Its surface is over 450 °C — hotter than Mercury, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun.

cards.fact: Mars is red because it's rusty.
cards.context: Iron oxide (the same stuff as rust) coats Martian dust and rocks, and fine red dust in its thin atmosphere tints the whole planet.

cards.headline: Inner solar system: mapped
learned: Four rocky planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars
Mars gets its red color from iron oxide

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the rocky inner planets?

options.label: Jupiter
options.rationale: Correct — Jupiter is a gas giant.

questions.explanation: The rocky inner planets are Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars. Jupiter is a gas giant.

questions.prompt: Why is Venus hotter than Mercury?

options.label: Venus is closer to the Sun
Venus has active volcanoes on its whole surface
options.rationale: Volcanism isn't what keeps it so hot.

questions.explanation: Venus's thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat, making it the hottest planet despite being second from the Sun.

questions.prompt: From Level 1: Earth is the third planet from the Sun. Which rocky planet comes next?

options.label: Venus
options.rationale: Venus is second, just inside Earth's orbit.

options.label: Mercury
options.rationale: Mercury is first, closest to the Sun.

options.label: Jupiter
options.rationale: Jupiter comes after Mars, and it's a gas giant.

questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars: Mars is fourth, the outermost of the rocky planets.
